text:
alex: Kicking off a guarded staged rollout for service: inference-gateway v3.2.1 -> 5% traffic. Asking for stop/go check from eng release ops. change window 21:00-22:00 PT.

deploy-bot: [automated] Rollout started: inference-gateway@v3.2.1 -> 5% (region: us-west-2). Pin=sha256:9f8c.., rollout_id=rl-20260321-01. To pause/abort: `deployctl rollout pause rl-20260321-01` / `deployctl rollback rl-20260321-01`.

kim: noted. what SLIs should we watch for the next 10m?

raj: primary: 5xx rate, p99 latency, token-cost spike. quick queries: `kubectl logs -lsvc=inference-gateway --since=10m | grep error` and `observability query "sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference\"}[1m])) by (code)`

nina: set rollback thresholds: if 5xx > 1.5% sustained for 3m OR p99 > 500ms for 5m -> rollback. also watch embeddings queue depth. tagging @ops-oncall for escalation path.

ops-oncall: acknowledged. our play: immediate rollback at >=2% 5xx OR latency >2x baseline for 5m. we'll open incident channel if triggered. Trying to avoid noisy alerts, so we'll correlate with batch.

alex: thanks. can we limit canary to non-paying internal traffic for first 10m? want to reduce user impact.

deploy-bot: canary routing rule applied: traffic.source != "customer" -> sends 100% of internal traffic in sample group; external traffic randomized 5%. See config snippet: ```routes:
  - match: "request.headers.x-internal == \"1\""
    weight: 100
  - match: "default"
    weight: 5
```

kim: good. I'll watch dashboards (latency, errors, cost) and call stop if anything smells.

raj: small sanity check on model variant: using quantized q4_0 path, kernel set = auto, KV cache warmup enabled. If we see kvcache OOMs, escalate to runtime.

deploy-bot: update: 5% rollout health @ +7m: requests=42k/min, 5xx=0.18%, p99=120ms, token-cost delta +3%. rollout_id=rl-20260321-01.

nina: looks green from my side. i ran a small eval set against inference-gateway@v3.2.1 and outputs matched baseline within tolerance.

ops-oncall: no noisy alerts. logs show two transient retried errors at 03:12:10 but they recovered. holding watch.

alex: quickvote to advance to 20%? please react with :thumbsup: to proceed or say hold. 30s.

kim: :thumbsup: proceed.

raj: :thumbsup: proceed, monitoring token-cost.

nina: :thumbsup: proceed.

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: proceed.

deploy-bot: [automated] Rollout update: scaled to 20% at 21:15 PT. rollout_id=rl-20260321-01. Next automated checkpoint at 21:30. To abort: `deployctl abort rl-20260321-01`.

alex: great. will leave the 21:30 checkpoint for another quickcheck. kim/raj/nina please post any anomalies here. i'll update release notes with the pinned version and change-window.

kim: noted — i'll also add a short blurb in the release notes: "v3.2.1 staged rollout: initial 5% -> 20% as of 21:15 PT, monitoring p99/5xx/token-cost."

raj: copying the rollout manifest to the thread for provenance: `s3://releases/rl-20260321-01/manifest.json`

ops-oncall: if anything hits thresholds i'll pause and ping infra pager. otherwise we'll keep gradual increments every 15m until 100%.

deploy-bot: [automated] Checkpoint @21:30 PT: rollout stable @20%. metrics: 5xx=0.22% (baseline 0.2%), p99=140ms. No rollback triggered.

alex: thanks everyone — holding this thread open until 22:00 PT, but current signal = go. will close after cutover completes.
